source.provenance: worn WHOOP MG, strap MGB0261172, firmware 50.33.2.0, finger on the electrode
source.channel: type-43 v0x0a middle channel at payload offset 0x11d
source.note: Raw converter counts straight off the strap, offset and all. Every other ECG fixture in this directory is synthetic, zero-mean and in millivolts, which is exactly the shape that hid the pedestal defect this fixture pins.

regression.before: Zero windows calibrated and the whole capture yielded one R peak. The band-pass starts from rest, so the converter pedestal drove a start transient that set the adaptive threshold above every real QRS, and the quality gate reported Contact forever.
